coverage: Hanson category 0 is assumed absence before the first precursor; Hanson category 2 is the uncertain 20 ms pre-onset convention. Comparison category 2 is the rwm_candidates screen, unlabelled and not negative. Category 1 has no duration rows here: only the raw onset points are verified. Reviewed negative coverage is unknown.

rules.present: no present duration inferred; verified point onsets remain in the curated format source
rules.absent: high-current time only before the first listed onset minus 100 ms, assuming complete onset listing. No post-onset physical absence is inferred without mode termination evidence
rules.uncertain: Hanson: [20 ms before ONSET_TIME, ONSET_TIME), of either mode number, as a convention with unverified direction and extent. Comparison: rwm_candidates screen spans.
rules.unassessed: explicit precursor holes and physical post-onset time to analysis end, apart from later uncertain onset windows; comparison time outside screen spans

onset_time_provenance.finding: Hanson source CSVs and category README name onset times but do not define growth-start versus detection/threshold timing. Piccione digests describe NSTX threshold t_RWM and cannot establish the meaning of Hanson's DIII-D ONSET_TIME.
onset_time_provenance.forecast_target: separate 100 ms point-time forecast target; unchanged

evidence_tiers.onset_window_uncertain: category 2 on Hanson shots: [o-20 ms, o) by convention; ONSET_TIME meaning, physical direction and extent unknown
evidence_tiers.assumed_absent: Hanson time before first precursor; completeness assumption
evidence_tiers.unlabelled_screen: category 2 on comparison shots: rwm_candidates screen spans, not onset windows or verified negatives
evidence_tiers.unassessed: no assessed physical state or termination evidence

reader_contract: review reader preserves all explicit rows and attrs; tier-less saves of tiered sources are rejected
